# authwise_access_conditions (Data Source)

A condition in an audience's Access catalog, which a binding can require. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `audience_id` (String) Parent identifier `audience_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `access_conditions` (Attributes List) Every access_condition under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_conditions))

<a id="nestedatt--access_conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_conditions`

Read-Only:

- `access_condition_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `description` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `expression` (String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
